items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: But that was before I went, he was in there before I went.

ctx.x: Did they have about two or three trumpets, uh?

They had, uh, once they, we had three trumpets, uh, two trumpets, yeah, it was two trumpets. Uh, Shirley Clay. Oh, yeah. And then once, uh, Bob Schauffman was in there. Oh, yeah. But that was before I went, he was in there before I went. Uh-huh.
Yeah. You made some records with Heinz too, I think, didn't you? Do you remember on Brunswick, was it, or?
